title: Storage Refresh
summary: Size replacement primary storage for the selected VMs: growth, data reduction and free-space headroom.
author: RVTools Analyzer examples

parameters.label: Include
parameters.help: Applied on top of the VM selection.

parameters.label: Size from
parameters.help: Guest used space comes from vPartition and needs VMware Tools. Provisioned size is the worst case for thick-provisioned targets.

parameters.label: Data reduction (compression + dedupe)
parameters.help: Use the vendor's assessed ratio for this workload mix; 1 = none.
